study: Target averaging, actual-holdings no-trade bands and matched shared-THINK ablation
history: 2022-2025 repeatedly inspected development history; seed robustness only, not untouched market confirmation
training: Only THINK is retrained: construct the matched ExtendedModel first, remove its stock-ID dense residual mixer and use its existing shared THINK stock scorer. Other initialized tensors match the old seeds exactly. Same objective, AdamW, batches, 12epochs, chronological folds and first-half validation loss selection. Dynamic forecasts reuse completed source fits, unchanged. Rank/snapshot/initial forecasts retained as diagnostics, not added to the account grid.
aggregation: rank_pool reproduces equal per-seed percentile-ranking blend. cohort_targets averages signed, independently risk-sized portfolios of consecutive predefined 5-seed cohorts; a five-seed group is unchanged. seed_targets averages signed per-seed matched-family portfolios. One account trades the averaged targets, not a mean of saved return paths. No leverage normalization after averaging; realized risk/exposure differences are reported.
bands_rule: At each original weekly decision, compare raw signed NAV target with preceding-close current economic holdings/NAV. Keep a component if its absolute change is <=band, it remains eligible, and no sign flip is requested. Force ineligible exits. Scale the complete proposal to gross1 if needed. Inherited prior-close sizing, next-close fills, ADV/funding rules, terminal liquidation, costs and borrow remain identical. Zero-band parity and independent dollar replay required.
risk: Inherited20% stock-basket volatility target,20sessions,QQQ continuous hedge cap75%,unused gross budget and QQQ volatility limits. No live trading or 2026 market scoring.
primary_goal: At base costs all five groups exceed original loss/issuer5/cap75 matched source Sharpe by at least0.01, minimum all-group Sharpe>1.10, and spread across the three disjoint groups<=0.15. Additionally the minimum all-group Sharpe under2xfees/6%borrow must not fall below the matched source baseline minimum. This is exploratory historical selection, not evidence of future Sharpe.
aspirational_goal: Separately report whether all five groups exceedSR1.5, without hiding lower results
selection: Among qualifying fixed recipes maximize minimum all-five-group base Sharpe; break exact ties by lower band then lexical recipe. Report every case including duplicate paths. No financial outcomes select checkpoints or seeds.
confirmation: If a recipe qualifies, freeze its exact rule before fitting the next5unused seeds in the October20 expansion list (new_seeds[10:15]). Compare the frozen candidate against source-style loss/issuer5 and its matched allocation, using all5seeds. No seed filtering or choice changes based on confirmation outcomes. This is new-initialization confirmation on spent market history, not a market holdout.
execution: Two isolated THINK year workers. Checkpoints retain optimizer and CUDA/CPU RNG; resume only identical frozen source/input math. Completed older runs are never edited. All outputs retained. A separate fixed confirmation protocol is required before confirmation training.
